pairs: Listen to what the Lord says:
contend in judgment against the mountains,
and let the hills hear your voice.
Let the mountains listen to the judgment of the Lord,
and the strong foundations of the earth.
quia judicium Domini cum populo suo,
For the judgment of the Lord is with his people,
and he will enter into judgment with Israel.
what have I done to you,
or how have I assailed you?
Quia eduxi te de terra Ægypti,
For I led you out of the land of Egypt,
et de domo servientium liberavi te,
and I freed you from the house of servitude,
et misi ante faciem tuam Moysen,
and I sent before your face Moses,
what Balak the king of Moab planned,
et quid responderit ei Balaam, filius Beor,
and how Balaam the son of Beor responded to him,
so that you may know the justice of the Lord.
What worthy thing might I offer to the Lord,
as I bend the knee before God on high?
How could I offer holocausts to him,
numquid placari potest Dominus in millibus arietum,
Would the Lord be pleased with thousands of rams,
aut in multis millibus hircorum pinguium?
or with many thousands of fat he-goats?
numquid dabo primogenitum meum pro scelere meo,
How could I give up my firstborn because of my evil deed,
fructum ventris mei pro peccato animæ meæ?
the fruit of my womb because of the sin of my soul?
et quid Dominus requirat a te:
and what the Lord requires from you,
and how to act with judgment,
et sollicitum ambulare cum Deo tuo.
and to walk carefully with your God.
The voice of the Lord cries out to the city,
et salus erit timentibus nomen tuum:
And salvation will be for those who fear your name.
Adhuc ignis in domo impii thesauri iniquitatis,
Nevertheless, there is a fire in the house of the impious, the treasury of iniquity,
and a small measure, filled with wrath.
and the deceitful weighing of a small bag?
In quibus divites ejus repleti sunt iniquitate,
By this, her wealthy have been filled with iniquity,
et habitantes in ea loquebantur mendacium,
and her inhabitants have spoken lies,
et lingua eorum fraudulenta in ore eorum.
and their tongue was deceitful in their mouth.
Et ego ergo cœpi percutere te perditione super peccatis tuis.
And I, therefore, began to strike you with perdition because of your sins.
et humiliatio tua in medio tui:
and your humiliation will be in your midst.
and those whom you will save,
I will deliver to the sword.
and not be anointed with oil,
For you have kept the precepts of Omri,
and all the works of the house of Ahab.
And you have walked according their wills,
so that I should give you over to perdition
et habitantes in ea in sibilum,
and you would carry the disgrace of my people.
